title: sonchus tenerrimus subsp. dianae
intro: Sonchus tenerrimus subsp. dianae, commonly known as the tender sow thistle, is a plant species within the dandelion-like genus Sonchus. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Sonchus tenerrimus subsp. dianae include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
